entities.name: Wizards' War
entities.description: Lim-Dul's second campaign to dominate Shandalar, fought against the five wizard schools founded by the Guardian.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: A necromancer who twice campaigned to dominate Shandalar and was defeated, his soul imprisoned in the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Guardian
entities.description: Founder of the five wizard schools of Shandalar who defeated Lim-Dul and imprisoned his soul.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: The plane Lim-Dul tried to dominate.

entities.name: Black Guildlord
entities.description: Guildlord of the black school, killed during the war.

entities.name: Azar
entities.description: The body from which Lim-Dul's soul was removed.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Magical artifact that imprisoned Lim-Dul's soul.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Necromancer lured by Lim-Dul's whispers who claimed the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Skavius Slan
entities.description: Lichlord reanimated from Azar's corpse who became black guildlord.

entities.name: Lim-Dul's War
entities.description: Earlier campaign in which Lim-Dul almost conquered all of Shandalar.

events.summary: The Black Guildlord was killed during the war while the other guildlords and the Guardian survived.
events.quote: The Black Guildlord was killed during this war

events.summary: Lim-Dul was defeated; the Guardian removed his soul from Azar's body and imprisoned it in the Chain Veil to power the Great Barrier.
events.quote: the Guardian removed the necromancer's soul from Azar ’s body

events.summary: Azar's soulless corpse was reanimated as the lichlord Skavius Slan, who became guildlord of the black guild.
events.quote: Azar's soulless corpse was reanimated as the lichlord Skavius Slan

events.summary: Almost a thousand years later Liliana Vess, lured by Lim-Dul's whispers, claimed the Chain Veil.
events.quote: claimed the relic in her quest for power

relations.note: The Guardian defeated him and imprisoned his soul.
relations.quote: imprisoned it within a magical artifact called the Chain Veil
